notes.mode:link: two consoles over a link cable: not reachable with one emulator

stages.open: names read off the Select Battle Stage scrolls ([Map 2] and [Map 3] in versus-2p-stage-map3-1); the scroll left of [Map 2] is not read yet

characters.open: only the default Vs. Mode cursors are named from screenshots so far

notes.event:ko: a fighter down for good (no health bar: one cut can kill)
notes.event:hit: a cut lands without a KO, shown on screen
notes.event:guard: a blocked cut, shown on screen
notes.event:save: data saved to a memory card
notes.event:load: data loaded from a memory card
